title: UPDATE 2-Chinese ship leaves after tense standoff near Taiwan-controlled islands
description:
A Chinese coast guard ship left waters near Taiwan's strategically located Pratas Islands at the top of the South China Sea on Sunday following a ‌tense standoff and verbal sparring between the coast guards, Taiwan's Coast Guard said.
China's ​Taiwan Affairs Office did not respond to a request for comment. Taiwan's coast guard said the ship eventually began sailing away from ⁠the Pratas late in the afternoon on Sunday.
